description: A run of atoll balance stopped after the copy was made and before the old one reached the trash: the next run has no copy to make, and sends the old one, which the plan marked surplus, to the trash.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]
mount = "${SANDBOX}/pool"
[[disk]]
id = "t1"
uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
tags = ["sata"]
[[disk]]
id = "t2"
uuid = "7a2b4c6d-8e0f-4a1b-9c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t2"
fs = "ext4"
tags = ["sata"]
[[disk]]
id = "t3"
uuid = "4f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t3"
fs = "ext4"
tags = ["usb"]

[[rule]]
label = "usb"
path = "**"
tags = ["usb"]
tags_mode = "strict"

steps.query: SELECT disk_id, created_by, state FROM copies ORDER BY disk_id
SELECT count(*) FROM trash t JOIN ops o ON o.id = t.op_id WHERE t.disk_id = 't2' AND t.reason = 'rebalance' AND o.state = 'done'
